Container.Name: protect-transcriber
Container.Overview:
Select a camera and a time range from your UniFi Protect recordings and get a transcript back from self-hosted Whisper instances. Exports the clip from the NVR, extracts the audio with ffmpeg, splits it on silence, and fans the chunks across every Whisper container you point it at (faster-whisper-server / Speaches, openai-whisper-asr-webservice, or whisper.cpp).
Requires a LOCAL UniFi Protect account (Local Access Only, no 2FA) -- that is what drives clip export. Set PROTECT_HOST, PROTECT_USERNAME, PROTECT_PASSWORD and WHISPER_INSTANCES below, then open the WebUI.
Full setup guide: https://github.com/tulathron-ultimate/protect-transcriber/blob/main/docs/unraid-setup.md

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI and API.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Clips, extracted audio, transcripts and the job database.

Config.Name: Protect Host
Config.Description: IP or hostname of the UDM / Cloud Key / NVR. No scheme.

Config.Name: Protect Username
Config.Description: A LOCAL Protect admin account (Local Access Only, no 2FA).

Config.Name: Whisper Instances
Config.Description: Comma separated: [name=]url[|kind][|model][|concurrency]. kind is auto, openai, asr_webservice or whisper_cpp. Example: faster=http://192.168.1.50:8000|openai|Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3|2,asr=http://192.168.1.50:9000|asr_webservice

Config.Name: Protect API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Used for the newer integration endpoints. Clip export still prefers the local account.

Config.Name: Verify SSL
Config.Description: UniFi uses a self-signed certificate, so this is normally false.

Config.Name: App Token
Config.Description: Optional shared secret. If set, open the UI as http://host:8099/?token=VALUE.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Leave blank to auto-detect, or set a code such as en.

Config.Name: Chunk Seconds
Config.Description: Audio per Whisper request. Lower this if a container times out.

Config.Name: Keep Clips
Config.Description: Keep the exported mp4 so the UI can play it back beside the transcript.

Config.Name: Retention Days
Config.Description: Delete finished jobs and their files after this many days. 0 disables.
